name: light fire
_note: without matches, with 2 stones: sparks, 1 h, catches 2 times in 3; the stones stay; the wood is only used when it catches
log: You strike one stone against the other over a nest of dry grass, again and again.
Stone on stone, sparks jumping into the tinder, most of them dying at once.
You knock the stones together until your knuckles bleed, coaxing sparks into the kindling.

text: A spark holds. You blow, and it becomes a flame.
One spark lands right. Smoke, a glow, then fire.
The tinder catches at last. You feed it twig by twig.
The sparks die in the tinder, one after another. Not this time.
Smoke, then nothing. The wood will keep for another try.
Your hands are numb before a spark holds.
